name: The Loop
source:
A lonely writer wakes up in the middle of the night. He doesn’t feel like he’s about to fall back asleep, so he gets up to have a drink. 

Something doesn’t feel quite right though…

What he doesn’t know is that he’s in a loop, stuck forever in an endless loop of the same mundane events at the hands of a mysterious ghastly clown figure. 
But not everything is as it seems… There are clues, riddles scattered around the false world of this insane dream, and it’s up to you to guide the protagonist 
into solving the puzzles laid out before him and escape from the loop!

[From [url=https://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=18679]Lemmasoft Forums[/url]]
translation:
一位孤独的作家在半夜醒来。他觉得自己不会再睡了，所以他起身去喝一杯。

但感觉有些不太对劲……

他不知道的是，他陷入了一个循环，永远陷入了一个神秘可怕的小丑人物手中的同样平凡事件的无休止循环中。
但并非一切都像看上去的那样……这个疯狂梦境的虚假世界中散布着线索和谜语，而你需要引导主角 
解决摆在他面前的谜题并逃离循环！

[来自[url=https://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=18679]Lemmasoft论坛[/url]]
